resources.string: Jetpack Compose is a modern toolkit for building native Android UI. Compose simplifies and accelerates UI development on Android with less code, powerful tools, and intuitive Kotlin APIs.

In this tutorial, you build a simple UI component with declarative functions. You call Compose functions to define what data you want to see and what UI elements you want to display, and the Compose compiler automatically transforms those function calls into a visible UI hierarchy.
